entries.message: logql: parser stage `| %s` is not yet supported
entries.rationale: every LineParserExpr op the pinned grammar produces (json / regexp / unpack / pattern) has its own case; bare `| logfmt` parses as LogfmtParserExpr

guard: past exhaustive switch st.Op over [case syntax.OpParserTypePattern; case syntax.OpParserTypeUnpack; case syntax.OpParserTypeJSON; case syntax.OpParserTypeRegexp]
